mechanism.claim: One-minute lead-lag asymmetry among six liquid dollar exchange rates forms a directed information-propagation network. During elevated BTC variation, a currency node that leads at least four peers with unusually strong net outgoing influence identifies a broad dollar impulse still propagating through global risk prices. Trade BTC opposite the canonical dollar direction of that source node for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the selected source node's completed canonical-dollar session return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDFXPR uses antisymmetric one-minute lagged cross-correlations and a unique directed source node. HVFXCSR used contemporaneous median pairwise synchronization and the median session direction; YLIRTR used USDJPY-to-BTC lag correlation. This candidate uses no BTC direction in its signal, no prior event set or control, and no funding, OI, premium, or crypto flow.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the immediately completed BTC 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, and the directed FX source strength must enter its causal upper 25%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse external directed FX-network clock is absent from Gross9

research_basis.primary_reference: Basnarkov, Stojkoski, Utkovski, and Kocarev (2020), Lead-lag relationships in foreign exchange markets, Physica A 539, 122986
research_basis.paper_object: one-minute FX lagged correlations, directed lead-lag networks, and influential currencies
research_basis.selection_boundary: the singleton universe, session, lag, graph law, ranks, side, clock, and hold were fixed without opening candidate incidence, Gross9 rows, or post-entry outcomes

fx_source.session: each weekday exact half-open [13:00,21:00) UTC session S
fx_source.validity: each symbol has at least 450 unique exact session minutes including no later than 13:05 and no earlier than 20:55, finite positive coherent OHLC, and every pair has at least 420 exact shared consecutive return pairs; no imputation

directed_network.edge: A(i,j)=corr(r_i[t],r_j[t+1])-corr(r_j[t],r_i[t+1]) on exact shared consecutive minutes; sample Pearson correlation with ddof=1; A(j,i)=-A(i,j)
directed_network.node_score: sum of A(i,j) over the other five nodes
directed_network.source_node: the unique strict maximum node_score; ties invalidate the session
directed_network.breadth: at least four of the five outgoing A(source,j) values are strictly positive
directed_network.source_strength: node_score of the source node, required finite and strictly positive
directed_network.direction: canonical session return of the source node from first valid session close to last valid session close, required strict nonzero

eligibility.source_strength_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 earlier valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.75
eligibility.btc_variation: sqrt(sum of squared 23 completed one-hour BTCUSDT perpetual log returns)) over the exact 24 completed hourly bars ending at the 21:00 UTC decision
eligibility.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 earlier valid FX sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
eligibility.rule: valid directed network, unique source, breadth>=4, source strength positive, source direction nonzero, source-strength rank>=0.75, and BTC-variation rank>=0.65

causal_label_authorization.allowed: only complete FX session and BTC hourly source rows ending at or before decision time

clock.decision: exact weekday 21:00 UTC after the FX session is complete
clock.side: opposite selected source-node canonical dollar session direction
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published one-minute directed FX lead-lag network mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no universe, session, lag, edge, graph, breadth, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, comparator, or control repair.
